name: preflight-commands
description: Tier 1 command gate. Keep the install step named "install" — the harness fingerprints it to skip reinstalling across attempts.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install workspace dependencies. Plain install, no --no-immutable: the committed lockfile is in sync, so this matches what CI does.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: ESLint across both workspaces. Must report zero errors.

commands.name: test
commands.purpose: 56 unit tests over the framework-free core. Offline and hermetic — the live-endpoint suite is deliberately separate so this never fails because testnet was slow.

commands.name: contract-test
commands.purpose: 17 contract tests, weighted toward revert paths. Uses test:ci, which runs WITHOUT HEDERA_FORKING: the default hardhat:test script enables the Hedera forking plugin, which makes these local tests fetch network state and time out under load. The tests were written to be environment-independent (see NOTES-failures.md #11), so forking buys nothing here and costs determinism.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: Production build, which also type-checks. Gate item G5.
